name: Synthesis
description: +1.5 regen and +25% healing. Your Grass attacks heal you a little (0.4% of HP per hit, up to 5 times per second).

name: Torrent Shell
description: +15 armor and +20 shield. Below 40% HP, +40% damage.

name: Ghost
description: You plow through the horde: -20% damage taken and +10% evasion.

name: Perseverance
description: +60% experience. With it, it reaches a fearsome evolution before anyone else (Lv. 40).

name: Vampire
description: +8% lifesteal and +20% healing.

name: Ancestral Gene
description: +10% damage, speed, area and HP. Can learn moves of any type.

name: Loyal Guardian
description: +10% speed. Every 3 s, nearby enemies are intimidated (they deal -40% damage).

name: Guardian Bone
description: +10 armor. Your bone attacks deal +20% damage. Below 40% HP, +35% damage.

name: Metamorphosis
description: +15% experience and +20 shield. Evolves soon (Metapod at Lv. 8, Butterfree at Lv. 36). As Metapod, the cocoon gives you +30 armor.

name: Poison Sting
description: +10% attack speed. Your crits poison and poisoned enemies take +20% damage. Evolves soon (Kakuna at Lv. 8, Beedrill at Lv. 36); as Kakuna, +30 armor.

name: Tailwind
description: +12% speed, +20% projectile speed and +1 jump. Like any good Flying type, you glide by holding Jump.

name: Serpent Glare
description: +1 regen (Shed Skin). Every 4 s your gaze paralyzes the enemies in front of you (7 m).

name: Sand Rush
description: +10 armor and +6% crit. In a sandstorm, +30% speed.

name: Lunar Blessing
description: +20 luck and +1 regen. Your Ultimate charges 30% faster and when you cast it you recover 15% HP.

name: Chlorophyll
description: +10% speed and +1 regen. In sun, +30% speed and +20% damage. Every 6 s you release a pollen cloud (4.5 m) that poisons.

name: Effect Spore
description: +20% status chance. Anyone who touches you falls asleep, gets paralyzed or gets poisoned. As Parasect, the mushroom is in control: +20% damage against enemies with any status.

name: Compound Eyes
description: +8% crit and +15% status chance. Confused enemies take +25% damage. As Venomoth, +12% attack speed.

name: Sand Trap
description: +10 armor. Every 2 s the ground shakes around you (4.5 m): it damages and traps enemies in the sand (root). As Dugtrio, 6 m.

name: Pickup
description: +40% PokéDollars and +2 pickup. Every 100 ₽ you earn in a run gives you +1% crit (up to +15%). As Persian, +10% speed.

name: Headache
description: +10% HP. The hits you take and the passage of time charge your headache; when full, it bursts into a psychic wave (7 m) that damages and confuses. As Golduck, the wave is 10 m and heals you for 8%.

name: Anger Point
description: +8 armor. Every hit you take enrages you: +6% damage per charge (up to 6; as Primeape, up to 8). The rage fades after 5 s without taking damage.

name: Swift Swim
description: +10% HP and +20% projectile speed. In rain, +30% speed and +20% damage. As Poliwrath, +15% physical damage.

name: Hungry Maw
description: +10% HP. Your Strikes and Spins deal +15% damage and can root (20%). KOs of rooted enemies heal you for 2% of HP.

name: Tentacles
description: +10 armor. Every 2 s your tentacles lash the 2 closest enemies within 7 m (they poison); Tentacruel lashes 4.

name: Sea of Flames
description: Below 40% HP, +40% damage. +10% Fire damage.
imageAlt: Charmander, partner with Sea of Flames

name: Sturdy
description: You survive a lethal hit with 1 HP once per run. +10 armor.

name: Poison Point
description: +15% HP and +10 armor. Anyone who touches you is poisoned, and poisoned enemies spread it when they die.

name: Static
description: Anyone who touches you is paralyzed. Every 4 s you fire a discharge at an enemy.

name: Cute Charm
description: Anyone who touches you is charmed. +5% evasion.

name: Guts
description: +25% physical damage.

name: Flash Fire
description: +20% Fire damage and +15% status damage.

name: Water Absorb
description: You take -15% damage. +0.5 regen.

name: Oblivious
description: +25% HP, +1.5 regen and -10% speed. Every 6 s you yawn: enemies within 6 m may fall asleep. As Slowbro, the Shellder on its tail gives you +20 armor.

name: Lucky Egg
description: +40% HP and +40% healing. Every 10 s you lay an egg beside you that heals you for 10% when picked up.

name: Giant Pincer
description: +6 armor. Your Strikes deal +20% damage. Every 5th hit of a Strike is a pincer that deals double damage and stuns (Kingler, every 4th).

name: Rock Head
description: +25 armor and +15% HP, in exchange for -8% speed. Your Charges deal +30% damage. Every 6 s rocks fall on the 3 closest enemies.

name: Hustle
description: +25% physical damage and +10% attack speed, in exchange for -8% HP.

name: Rivalry
description: +10% damage and +25% against elites, Alphas and bosses.

name: Flame Body
description: Anyone who touches you is burned. Burned enemies you defeat burst into flames (3 m) and burn those around them.

name: Fossil Armor
description: +15 armor. Each hit you take is reduced by 3 + 0.3 per level. As Kabutops, your Strikes and Boomerangs deal +20% damage.

name: Gluttony
description: +30% healing.

name: Mold Breaker
description: +15% damage. You ignore enemy shields (like Fighting attacks) and deal +20% to bosses and mini-bosses. Storm Throw is always a crit.

name: Iron Fist
description: +5% physical damage. Your punches (attacks with "punch") deal +20% damage. Every 3 s you throw an automatic punch at the closest enemy within 4 m.

name: Magnet
description: +4 pickup range. Every 4 s a magnetic pulse pulls in enemies within 9 m and may paralyze them. As Magneton, the pulse also damages them.

name: Technician
description: +15% attack speed and +10% damage.

name: Adaptability
description: +25% damage with moves of your own type (the type bonus goes from ×1.25 to ×1.56).

name: Skill Link
description: +20 armor and +1 projectile. As Cloyster, +1 projectile and +10 more armor.

name: Multiscale
description: At full HP you take -50% damage.

name: Magic Guard
description: Immune to damage from the ground (lava, fire pools, cracks, spore clouds). -30% damage from projectiles and area attacks.

name: Sniper
description: +8% crit and +50% crit damage.

name: Water Veil
description: +10% evasion. Every dodge wraps you in water: a shield worth 6% of your HP. As Seaking, +5% evasion.

name: Polar Fat
description: +15% HP and +10 armor. Every 4 s ice shards burst around you (5 m) and gradually freeze enemies. As Dewgong, 6.5 m.

name: Fiery Hooves
description: +15% speed. As you move you leave fire footprints that burn enemies. As Rapidash, +10% speed and bigger footprints.

name: Sharpened Leek
description: +10% crit. You always carry a leek: 4% of your hits are an ×8 "Bonk!" (stacks with the Leek item).

name: Twin Heads
description: +10% speed. Each attack has a 25% chance to repeat instantly with the other head. As Dodrio, 35%.

name: Muddy Body
description: -15% damage taken. When hit, you leave a toxic puddle for 4 s that poisons and traps anyone who steps in it. As Muk, the puddles are bigger.

name: Pendulum
description: +10% status chance. Every 7 s your pendulum puts the 3 closest enemies to sleep (Hypno, 5). Sleeping enemies within 6 m heal you for 0.5% of HP per second each (up to 5).

name: Aftermath
description: +15% speed. Enemies you defeat have a 12% chance to explode (3 m, Electric damage that paralyzes); with Electrode, 20%.

name: Harvest
description: +20% healing. Every 15 s a berry appears beside you. As Exeggutor, +10% area.

name: Rubber Kicks
description: +20% area and +1 jump. Your kicks (attacks with "kick") deal +20% damage.

name: Long Tongue
description: +4 pickup range and +20% HP. Every 4 s your tongue grabs the closest enemy within 8 m, pulls it toward you and paralyzes it.

name: Toxic Cloud
description: You levitate: hold Jump to glide and you can climb walls. A 4 m gas cloud surrounds you and poisons every second. As Weezing, 5.5 m.

name: Unstoppable Charge
description: +15 armor. After 1.5 s of running without stopping, you charge: enemies you touch take damage and are sent flying.

name: Vines
description: +2 regen. Every 5 s your vines trap (root) and damage the 4 closest enemies within 7 m.

name: Parental Bond
description: Your baby fights alongside you: every hit of your attacks is repeated at 25% of its damage.

name: Ink
description: +10% crit and +25% crit damage. Your crits cover the enemy in ink and blind it: it deals -40% damage and common enemies stop attacking.

name: Core
description: +20% projectile speed. Every 8 s your core heals you for 5%. As Starmie, +10% special damage.

name: Invisible Wall
description: Every 6 s you raise an invisible barrier: a shield worth 10% of your HP and a wall that pushes back enemies within 4 m.
imageAlt: Mr. Mime, partner with Invisible Wall

name: Icy Kiss
description: Anyone who touches you is charmed. Your hits on charmed enemies gradually freeze them.

name: Motor Drive
description: Every time you paralyze an enemy you gain +2% damage for 4 s (up to 15 stacks).

name: Stampede
description: +15% speed. While running, every 0.5 s you ram the enemies in front of you (2.5 m): damage and a good shove.

name: Transformation
description: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 30 s you copy the types of the nearest enemy: your type bonus and your weaknesses change.

name: Download
description: +12% special damage and projectile speed. Every 10 s you download data: your next 5 hits are crits.

name: Spiral Shell
description: +20 armor. Your Rock and Water attacks deal +15% damage. Every 5 s, a ring of rocks bursts from your shell (5 m; Omastar 6.5 m).

name: Prehistoric Wings
description: +15% speed and +1 jump; you glide by holding Jump. While airborne, your attacks deal +25% damage.

name: Frigid Pressure
description: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every second, enemies within 6 m gradually freeze.

name: Electric Pressure
description: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 5 s three lightning bolts strike nearby enemies and paralyze them.

name: Fiery Pressure
description: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 6 s a 6 m ring of flames burns the enemies.

name: Genome
description: +15% damage, area and speed. Every 8 s a psychic barrier gives you a shield worth 15% of your HP. Your crits stun.
